name: Pyreside Waltz
source:
A serendipitous collision, a mystery, and a city of life and colour come together under the falling blossom...

Pyreside Waltz is a fantasy-romance visual novel set in a fictional kingdom inspired by Russian fairytales. Though the game will include some light body horror imagery and dramatic elements, it is a romance at its core, with a focus on getting to know the various characters and seeing how their lives intertwine.

[Edited from [url=https://inkethic.itch.io/pyreside-waltz]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一次机缘巧合的碰撞、一桩谜团，以及一座生机盎然、色彩斑斓的城市，在纷飞的花瓣下交汇……

《Pyreside Waltz》是一部奇幻恋爱视觉小说，舞台是一个受俄罗斯童话启发的虚构王国。游戏虽包含轻度的身体恐怖画面与戏剧性情节，核心依然是爱情，着重描绘玩家如何了解不同角色，以及他们的人生怎样彼此交织。

[编译自[url=https://inkethic.itch.io/pyreside-waltz]itch.io[/url]]
